property_summary: For any player that sends exactly TICKET_AMOUNT to play, the reference contract always empties the pot after a winning play (pot becomes 0), while the mutant that removed the fee transfer still sets pot to 0 on win — therefore this summary is wrong; correction: The reference always transfers FEE_AMOUNT to bank on a winning play, which decreases address(c).balance by FEE_AMOUNT relative to just before the transfer; the mutant retains that FEE_AMOUNT, so there exists an input (one that causes the win branch) where address(c).balance is larger for the mutant — we will express a general rule: after a single play by any player sending exactly TICKET_AMOUNT and causing a win, address(c).balance equals 0 in the reference iff the bank received the fee (i.e., address(c).balance before play plus ticket minus FEE equals resulting balance) — we assert that after play by any player sending exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, either pot==0 and address(c).balance <= TICKET_AMOUNT * 0 (i.e., observed invariant: pot is zero after win); the test instead uses pot getter to assert that for any single play where balance decreases (meaning fee was paid) pot==0 — this distinguishes the mutant.
change_summary: Remove the fee transfer so the bank is not paid when a win occurs.
